rows.note: Use 嘻哈 as the all-purpose everyday noun for hip-hop when the context already makes clear whether you mean the culture or the music.

example.english: I started listening to hip-hop when I was young, and I still love it.
example.traditional: 我細個就開始聽嘻哈，依家仲係好鍾意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 ci2 teng1 hei1 haa1 ji1 gaa1 zung6 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3

rows.note: Choose 嘻哈文化 when you specifically mean the wider youth culture and its associated lifestyle and art forms.

example.english: Keung wants to learn about hip-hop culture, so he signed up for breakdancing lessons.
example.traditional: 阿強想了解嘻哈文化，所以報名學街舞。
example.jyutping: aa3 koeng4 soeng2 liu5 gaai2 hei1 haa1 man4 faa3 so2 ji5 bou3 meng2 hok6 gaai1 mou5

rows.note: Choose 嘻哈音樂 when you specifically mean the music genre, especially when talking about listening to or performing it.

example.english: Ming is doing his homework with hip-hop music playing in the background.
example.traditional: 阿明做緊功課，播住嘻哈音樂做背景。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 zou6 gan2 gung1 fo3 bo3 zyu6 hei1 haa1 jam1 ngok6 zou6 bui3 ging2
